claim_ceiling: This establishes a developmental-environment effect, not a CFE mechanism inside Microseed. The terrain adapter externally determines which raw-coordinate relation is jointly visible while episode count/order, action/effect stream, opaque marginal exposures and projection search budget remain matched. Current Microseed has no owned terrain/topology/currentness surface, so the geometry itself is not an organism-owned causal object and cannot yet be staled/qualified as terrain.
observed: GOOD_XY and BAD_XZ conditions used the exact same underlying event IDs/order, action tokens, effect tokens, sample count and fixed ProjectionDiscoveryConfig search budget.
The two visible-coordinate channels had identical opaque marginal counts (96/96 for each token in each coordinate); only which relation was co-visible changed.
Causal GOOD_XY terrain produced an exact two-coordinate candidate at validation accuracy 1.0 with strong lift; matched BAD_XZ and BAD_ZY terrains produced no qualified candidate.
Pure coordinate permutation GOOD_XY -> GOOD_YX preserved discovery, so the effect is not coordinate order/label identity.
Removing then restoring causal co-visibility removed then restored discovery with no organism mutation or extra experience budget.
No developmental_geometry, terrain_topology, relational_visibility_graph, or cfe_field owner exists on current Microseed.
oarr: Incumbent geometry-invariant explanation is falsified only for externally controlled relation co-visibility. Rival interpretation that this is merely evidence/access topology remains valid and is explicitly the transfer boundary; no internal CFE geometry mechanism is inferred.
